static_traits.name: Luo Wei
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to talk with, but has not yet shared the depth of Self-doubt and worthlessness; Interpersonal relationships are affected, often seeking recognition of my work from friends
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but clear expression, fairly cooperative; clear logic, able to identify and describe automatic thoughts; marked Self-denial tendency

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will never be good enough as a Photographer and unable to be published, which makes me feel worthless and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize Self-doubt is hindering my progress in my photography career and affecting my mental health, so I have decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After starting photography as a career, first submitted with excitement, but submissions to multiple magazines were rejected; then Increasing stress, gradually developing into complete avoidance of submitting to avoid being rejected again; whenever thinking about submitting or comparing with published Photographer, strong Self-doubt and worthlessness appear; tried seeking recognition from friends and family, but it has not yet eased Self-doubt.

special_situations.event: The moment of thinking about submitting work to magazines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected again, it proves I will never be good enough and have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoiding submissions to avoid Being rejected and shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely be Being rejected; the result will only be terrible

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of being rejected by magazines before
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One or a few rejections mean I will never succeed, and the work is objectively not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces the frequency of creating and submitting; procrastinates on projects to reduce frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I am not capable; there will be no change in the future

special_situations.event: Comparing with published Photographer and their works
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching their level and being published counts as valuable; otherwise a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequent self-criticism and abandoning or delaying projects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never reach their level; I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: When friends and family give positive feedback and encouragement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless published by a magazine, others' affirmation is not credible and does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to seek external validation but negating the positive information in it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me; this praise does not count

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to have works published, and to be truly seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and being negated, worrying about exposing the truth of my own 'worthlessness/not good enough'
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of security by avoiding submissions, reducing the possibility of Being rejected
Temporarily easing Anxiety and Self-doubt by seeking others' recognition

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough creator who may be Being rejected at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially magazine Editor/published Photographer) are harsh judges and rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about submitting to a magazine, or when invited in counseling to make a concrete submission plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating possible feedback as inevitable rejection, experiencing others (Editor/counselor) as picky judges (transference: others will negate me)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'now is not the time' in a cautious and Withdrawal tone, raising many practical difficulties, avoiding definite commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to accept friends' positive feedback or discuss self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others' affirmation is not real and just perfunctory (transference: others outwardly support but inwardly negate)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Questioning others' motives and authenticity, in a defensive tone, emphasizing 'they will not understand', and trying to change the topic.

manifestations: Treating 'being published' as the sole standard of self-worth; not yet being published is experienced as worthlessness
Self-doubt and failure feelings reinforcing confusion about the meaning of creation
Living alone but not yet sharing the depth of inner pain with friends
Worries about being misunderstood or evaluated, reduces real contact
outcomes: Seeking external validation but struggling to internalize self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Multiple Self-denial and cautious expression in sessions
Adopting overly cautious and Withdrawal strategies toward submissions
Unwilling to share deeper feelings for fear of being misunderstood

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming friends will not understand me, worrying about being judged as 'pretentious'
Judging that others will negate or be perfunctory toward me without confirmation

positive_force: Willing to try cognitive restructuring and small steps
Able to Identify automatic thoughts, willing to practice outside sessions
Has a certain level of social support (has friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Marked catastrophizing and predicting-the-future cognitive patterns
Black-and-white thinking and excessive comparison with others
Avoids submissions and project procrastination, depends on external validation
Self-worth overly bound to 'being published', negating positive feedback
Overgeneralization of failure experiences, reinforcing Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding submitting to magazines and delaying creative projects
antecedent: When thinking of submitting a manuscript
Seeing or comparing published Photographer' works
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing Being rejected and being negated, with the core cognition 'I am not good enough/have no value'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame, briefly reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Hindered Career development, fewer opportunities, Declining motivation and productivity

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeking approval from friends and family
antecedent: After comparing with others or thinking about submitting
target_behavior.core_reason: Easing unease and Self-doubt through external validation, finding it hard to internalize self-worth
target_behavior.function: Gaining comfort and short-term emotional buffering
target_behavior.consequence: Increased dependence on external evaluation, decreased autonomous evaluation ability, Self-doubt persisting
